requirements.description: Create, clone, rename, version, recover and organize complete projects.
Edit dimensions, height, terrain, collision, props, lighting, camera and navigation.
Edit deployment, objectives, waves, boss phases, triggers and rewards.
Edit combat formulas, targeting, statuses, reactions, timing and difficulty.
Edit jobs, ability boards, lessons, unlocks, supports and growth.
Edit companions, enemies, summons, stats, loadouts and behavior profiles.
Edit gear, consumables, shops, recipes, loot and transaction rules.
Edit routes, quests, factions, recruitment, choices and endings.
Edit dialogue, codex, speaker portraits, subtitles and localized strings.
Create layered pixel art, palettes, tiles, portraits, icons and source sheets.
Edit frames, durations, directions, pivots, events and state transitions.
Import/edit modular props, materials, collision and environment prefabs.
Edit effect clips, emitters, trails, curves, blending, anchors and resource budgets.
Compose/import/edit notes, patterns, arrangements, stems, tempo, loops and adaptive transitions.
Synthesize, record/import, layer, trim and automate original gameplay/UI sound effects.
Edit ambient beds, emitters, dialogue recordings, subtitles and localized audio.
Edit buses, effects, loudness, spatialization, variations and resolved-event cue bindings.
Edit UI layouts/themes/fonts, menus, input maps and accessibility defaults.
Edit custom rules/runtime source and versioned extension modules with reproducible builds.
Expose the same editing transactions to UI, CLI and agent/API clients.
Playtest exact builds with seeds, breakpoints, inspector, performance and validation reports.
Import/export editable projects preserving source layers, graphs, code and stable IDs.
Export a playable game plus editable payload and reimport it into a clean studio.
Manage engine/project/save versions, dependencies, offline behavior and deployment targets.

decisions.recommendation: Versioned project package with stable IDs, source assets and engine/source lock.
Compile project content into the shared deterministic runtime; keep editor state separate.
Default to playable plus editable project/source payload; label runtime-only mode explicitly.
Preserve source PCM/graphs and define supported import/decode/export adapters per target.
Version extension APIs and include buildable source; imported code activation is explicit.
Preserve layers, palettes, frames, pivots and timing instead of treating packed atlases as masters.
Use one serializable graph/cue contract for realtime preview, offline render and game runtime.
Separate project/engine/build/save identities and validate update/migration before activation.

stages.name: Runtime content seam
stages.acceptance: Compile validated project content into the current runtime; preserve existing IDs, rules and save fixtures.

stages.name: Workspace and transactions
stages.acceptance: Create/recover a project; stable IDs, undo/redo, revision checks and asset ownership work.

stages.name: Level and mission authoring
stages.acceptance: Build and play one alternate map/objective using real editor controls and the shared runtime.

stages.name: Game systems and campaign
stages.acceptance: Author a complete route, actors, jobs, abilities, economy, dialogue, UI and localization.

stages.name: Visual source authoring
stages.acceptance: Edit layered pixels, frames/directions, pivots and prop assets; compiled output matches preview.

stages.name: Effects and presentation
stages.acceptance: Author bounded effect/particle graphs and bind them to resolved events with reduced-motion alternatives.

stages.name: Music and sound studio
stages.acceptance: Compose music, synthesize/layer SFX, edit ambience/voice and mix/bind cues in a playable preview.

stages.name: Automation and code extensions
stages.acceptance: UI/API/CLI share typed transactions; custom rules/source changes build, diagnose and round-trip.

stages.name: Project and playable export
stages.acceptance: Export complete-game bundle; import in a clean studio; play the result with source editing intact.

stages.name: Authoring release gate
stages.acceptance: Pass full golden-project round trips, supported-device/editor access checks, migration and offline/update rehearsals.

workItems.name: Current-game content adapter

workItems.name: Canonical schema and identities

workItems.name: Project browser and revisions

workItems.name: Typed transactions and undo

workItems.name: Asset/dependency browser

workItems.name: Schema-driven inspectors
workItems.acceptance: Inspect/edit fields, units, constraints and references through common commands.

workItems.name: Project recovery and conflicts
workItems.acceptance: Recover a consistent revision and reject stale conflicting writes.

workItems.name: Editor navigation and diagnostics

workItems.name: Map source document

workItems.name: Terrain brushes and region edits

workItems.name: Props and environment placement

workItems.name: Objective/failure graph editor
workItems.acceptance: Define counters and precedence; test win/fail/retry/resume.

workItems.name: Waves and boss phases

workItems.name: Map/mission validation view

workItems.name: Exact mission playtest
workItems.acceptance: Run a chosen revision/seed through the same runtime as export.

workItems.name: Actor and AI profile editors
workItems.acceptance: Edit roster identity/stats/roles and inspect legal AI choices.

workItems.name: Rules/jobs/ability boards

workItems.name: Items, shops and recipes

workItems.name: Campaign, dialogue and quests

workItems.name: UI/theme/control schemas

workItems.name: Localization and voice references

workItems.name: Content graph validation

workItems.name: Layered pixel source format

workItems.name: Pixel tools and selections
workItems.acceptance: Brush/erase/fill/select/transform/clipboard edits round-trip and undo.

workItems.name: Layers and palette workflow
workItems.acceptance: Reorder/group/opacity and indexed/RGBA edits preserve source and transparent semantics.

workItems.name: Visual import adapters

workItems.name: Portrait/icon/UI asset tools

workItems.name: Geometry/material/prefab inspector

workItems.name: Visual source compiler

workItems.name: Timeline/clip schema

workItems.name: Frame/cel editing

workItems.name: Onion skin and loop audition

workItems.name: Pivots, directions and attachments

workItems.name: State/event binding editor

workItems.name: Packing and registration compiler

workItems.name: Runtime motion review

workItems.name: Emitter and shape tools

workItems.name: Curves and modulation

workItems.name: Trails/projectile anchoring

workItems.name: Budget/quality profiles

workItems.name: Resolved-event effect bindings
workItems.acceptance: Hit/miss/heal/buff/prop cues consume deduplicable resolved facts.

workItems.name: Low-motion/intensity alternatives
workItems.acceptance: Edit static/low-intensity alternatives without gameplay timing changes.

workItems.name: Compile and preview effect graphs
workItems.acceptance: Export/reopen graphs and validate compiled clips, fallback and teardown.

workItems.name: Audio source/graph/time contract
workItems.acceptance: Define project sample/tick clocks, versioned nodes and source/master ownership.

workItems.name: Instrument rack
workItems.acceptance: Create oscillator/sample instruments with envelopes, filters and modulation.

workItems.name: Piano roll and note commands
workItems.acceptance: Edit pitch/start/duration/velocity and audition through UI/API.

workItems.name: Patterns and arrangement
workItems.acceptance: Reuse patterns, arrange/split/loop clips and preserve editable note sources.

workItems.name: Tempo/meter and automation
workItems.acceptance: Edit musical-time maps and parameter curves with explicit render scheduling.

workItems.name: Stems and loop regions
workItems.acceptance: Route aligned stems and audition repeat/crossfade/tail boundaries.

workItems.name: Adaptive music transitions
workItems.acceptance: Bind region/battle/phase state at declared musical boundaries without replayed stings.

workItems.name: Offline render and parity
workItems.acceptance: Bounce master/stems under shared graph semantics; compare source/PCM/loop parity.

workItems.name: SFX synthesis graph
workItems.acceptance: Create original oscillator/noise/sample effects with editable nodes.

workItems.name: Non-destructive waveform editor
workItems.acceptance: Trim/split/fade/reverse/normalize/loop original sources with retained edit lists.

workItems.name: Layered sound design
workItems.acceptance: Layer transients/body/tails; edit envelopes, filters, pitch sweeps and modulation.

workItems.name: Recording and sample import

workItems.name: Variants, spatialization and cue policy

workItems.name: Mixer and shared DSP engine

workItems.name: Codec/render adapters

workItems.name: Ambience, voice and subtitles

workItems.name: Capability/schema discovery

workItems.name: Typed domain commands
workItems.acceptance: UI/API/CLI share validated changes and stable document IDs.

workItems.name: Batch/conflict/diff workflow
workItems.acceptance: Stage, diff, validate, commit/abort with actionable source errors and recovery.

workItems.name: Pixel/music/SFX automation
workItems.acceptance: Agent commands edit actual layers, notes and sound nodes, not only flattened outputs.

workItems.name: Scenario/debug result API
workItems.acceptance: Return real preview builds, seeds, rule results, visual/audio auditions and diagnostics.

workItems.name: Versioned code/inspector extensions
workItems.acceptance: Edit/export source modules and custom inspectors with explicit API compatibility.

workItems.name: Engine-source build workspace
workItems.acceptance: Preserve engine overrides, build scripts and locks; clean rebuild needs no hidden vendor source.

workItems.name: UI/API/CLI parity proof
workItems.acceptance: Complete representative edits in every domain through both UI and automation.

workItems.name: Artifact and compatibility schemas
workItems.acceptance: Separate project/complete-game/runtime/asset/save/source formats and identity/version rules.

workItems.name: Lossless source project export
workItems.acceptance: Include rich sources, code, provenance and dependency closure; reopen to edit again.

workItems.name: Staged project/complete-bundle import
workItems.acceptance: Inspect, map conflicts, validate and commit without partially replacing a workspace.

workItems.name: Shared runtime compiler
workItems.acceptance: Build exact preview/export runtime with all required code, content, visuals and audio.

workItems.name: Default Complete game bundle
workItems.acceptance: Ship playable output plus editable payload and matching buildable engine source.

workItems.name: Launch/static-host profiles
workItems.acceptance: Test local preview launch and root/subpath hosting without studio/backend dependencies.

workItems.name: Save/offline/update compatibility
workItems.acceptance: Keep project/play saves separate and rehearse compatible update/cache/migration paths.

workItems.name: Golden game and clean re-edit proof
workItems.acceptance: Author, play, export, import, re-edit and rebuild the complete fixture in a clean environment.

artifactProfiles.label: Editable project
artifactProfiles.purpose: Open/edit or transfer the canonical project; no compiled player required.

artifactProfiles.label: Complete game bundle (default)
artifactProfiles.purpose: Play and reimport into the studio with complete authoring sources.

artifactProfiles.label: Play-only web build
artifactProfiles.purpose: Smaller distribution; source layers/graphs cannot be guaranteed recoverable.

artifactProfiles.label: Reusable asset pack
artifactProfiles.purpose: Import selected reusable assets with conflict mapping; not a complete game/project.

artifactProfiles.label: Player progress backup
artifactProfiles.purpose: Restore player progress for a compatible game; not authoring content.

artifactProfiles.label: Source/developer export
artifactProfiles.purpose: Rebuild and extend the game's implementation outside the studio.

acceptanceCases.name: Current-game template
acceptanceCases.action: Compile the existing project template and replay baseline scenarios.
acceptanceCases.expected: Equivalent current rules, IDs, resources and RNG; no editor-only simulation.

acceptanceCases.name: Workspace recovery
acceptanceCases.action: Create/clone/checkpoint, interrupt an edit session and reopen.
acceptanceCases.expected: One consistent reviewed project revision; player saves remain separate.

acceptanceCases.name: Atomic editing and undo
acceptanceCases.action: Apply a valid batch and an invalid/stale batch; undo/redo the accepted edit.
acceptanceCases.expected: No partial source changes; revision and asset history match.

acceptanceCases.name: Level design
acceptanceCases.action: Resize/paint elevation/collision, place props and select corners.
acceptanceCases.expected: Map/rule/world/input agreement and retained authored source.

acceptanceCases.name: Mission authoring
acceptanceCases.action: Edit deployment, objective, wave, phase and rewards; play fail/retry/win.
acceptanceCases.expected: Approved counter/terminal order, no duplicate spawns or settlement.

acceptanceCases.name: Rules and progression
acceptanceCases.action: Edit a formula/status/reaction, ability board, job unlock and support.
acceptanceCases.expected: Preview/resolution/learning/save contracts agree.

acceptanceCases.name: Actors and AI
acceptanceCases.action: Edit an enemy/companion/summon build and AI role.
acceptanceCases.expected: Legal deterministic behavior and stable identity/ownership.

acceptanceCases.name: Economy
acceptanceCases.action: Edit gear, consumable, shop, recipe and loot/settlement policy.
acceptanceCases.expected: Costs/output/ownership commit once; invalid actions preserve state.

acceptanceCases.name: Campaign and quests
acceptanceCases.action: Create a route with choices, recruit/faction consequence and ending.
acceptanceCases.expected: Required paths reachable; branch/restoration/settlement consistent.

acceptanceCases.name: Dialogue/localization
acceptanceCases.action: Edit speaker/portrait/choice, codex, subtitle and locale strings.
acceptanceCases.expected: Commit/cancel and long/missing-string diagnostics; source keys preserved.

acceptanceCases.name: Pixel document
acceptanceCases.action: Paint/transform pixels, edit layers and indexed/RGBA palette.
acceptanceCases.expected: Layer/cel/palette/source pixels reopen exactly; packed output remains a derivative.

acceptanceCases.name: Animation
acceptanceCases.action: Edit frames, durations, directions, pivots, events and transitions.
acceptanceCases.expected: Game-scale playback, interruption/down/revive and source timing agree.

acceptanceCases.name: Environment source
acceptanceCases.action: Import/edit geometry, materials, prefabs, lights and collision.
acceptanceCases.expected: Rendered and rule footprints agree; editable source/dependency references survive.

acceptanceCases.name: VFX
acceptanceCases.action: Author emitters, curves, sprite/trail anchors and quality/motion alternatives.
acceptanceCases.expected: Bounded result-driven playback, fallback and teardown.

acceptanceCases.name: Music composition
acceptanceCases.action: Create an instrument and piano-roll phrase; edit pitch, duration and velocity.
acceptanceCases.expected: Editable note/instrument sources survive with audible compiled result.

acceptanceCases.name: Arrangement and stems
acceptanceCases.action: Arrange patterns, tempo/meter, automation, stems and loops.
acceptanceCases.expected: Aligned render and transitions follow the declared sample/tick policy.

acceptanceCases.name: Original sound synthesis
acceptanceCases.action: Create a new layered SFX from noise/oscillators/samples and envelopes.
acceptanceCases.expected: Graph/node/source layers remain editable after export/import.

acceptanceCases.name: Waveform and takes
acceptanceCases.action: Record/import a take, trim/split/fade/reverse/normalize and loop.
acceptanceCases.expected: Original PCM plus edit list preserved; supported codec conversion explicit.

acceptanceCases.name: Mixing
acceptanceCases.action: Route music/SFX/ambience/voice/UI buses, sends, ducking and automation.
acceptanceCases.expected: Realtime/offline/runtime parity under the declared graph/toolchain settings.

acceptanceCases.name: Audio cue binding
acceptanceCases.action: Bind hit/miss/footstep/UI/phase cues with variants, caps and cooldowns.
acceptanceCases.expected: Resolved facts and deduplication correct; no combat RNG consumed.

acceptanceCases.name: Ambience and voice
acceptanceCases.action: Place an emitter/bed; bind locale voice and subtitle; mute/resume.
acceptanceCases.expected: Loop/spatial/subtitle fallback and source editability survive.

acceptanceCases.name: UI and controls
acceptanceCases.action: Edit title/HUD/theme/input/accessibility defaults and play supported controls.
acceptanceCases.expected: Complete new-game-to-settlement path with focus and readable feedback.

acceptanceCases.name: Code extension/source
acceptanceCases.action: Edit a custom rule/runtime module and buildable source export.
acceptanceCases.expected: Included API/dependency/source locks reproduce the behavior in a clean build.

acceptanceCases.name: Automation parity
acceptanceCases.action: Repeat representative map/pixel/note/SFX/rule/UI edits through UI and API/CLI.
acceptanceCases.expected: Equivalent project diffs, undo and diagnostics; no hidden-only edit path.

acceptanceCases.name: Exact playable preview
acceptanceCases.action: Run asset, mission and full-game preview from a named revision/build.
acceptanceCases.expected: Actual exported runtime semantics, isolated saves and inspectable results.

acceptanceCases.name: Default complete export
acceptanceCases.action: Export Complete game and inspect its members/dependency report.
acceptanceCases.expected: Playable runtime plus all editable masters/graphs/code and engine/build locks.

acceptanceCases.name: Clean complete reimport
acceptanceCases.action: Import default bundle in a clean compatible studio with original workspace unavailable.
acceptanceCases.expected: Source IDs/graphs/pixels/PCM/code preserved; re-edit each major domain and rebuild.

acceptanceCases.name: Project/pack/source transfers
acceptanceCases.action: Export project, selected asset pack and source; import with ID conflicts.
acceptanceCases.expected: Lossless whole-project/source modes and explicit partial-pack remapping.

acceptanceCases.name: Play-only launch
acceptanceCases.action: Build runtime-only and launch via local preview/root/subpath static host.
acceptanceCases.expected: Playable without studio/backend/original repo; missing rich-source guarantee disclosed.

acceptanceCases.name: Save compatibility
acceptanceCases.action: Export/import player progress across compatible and incompatible edited builds.
acceptanceCases.expected: Declared compatibility/migration or explicit rejection without lost progress.

acceptanceCases.name: Offline/update/lifecycle
acceptanceCases.action: Rehearse chosen offline profile, interrupted update and background/resume.
acceptanceCases.expected: Compatible cached build/assets/saves; graphics/audio resources recover or dispose.

acceptanceCases.name: Import/build failures
acceptanceCases.action: Import corrupt/missing/unsupported content, codec or extension and attempt export.
acceptanceCases.expected: Actionable diagnostics, original project intact, last valid build accurately labeled.
